system_description.narrative_title: Drone and Black Sea escalation in the Russia–Ukraine war
system_description.narrative_summary: The dominant narrative is an intensifying phase of the Russia–Ukraine conflict driven by long-range drones, missile strikes and maritime (Black Sea) attacks that are straining logistics, airspace security and regional deterrence. As an open system it takes inputs (weapons transfers, intelligence, cargo flows, diplomatic pressure) and produces outputs (port closures, strikes inside Russia, NATO engagements, sanctions, domestic repression and economic adjustments) with feedback loops that drive escalation, rerouting of trade, and reciprocal targeting of logistics and critical infrastructure. These interactions cross national borders, draw in NATO and neighbouring states, and couple military, economic and information subsystems, raising risks of wider confrontation and persistent disruption to energy and grain exports.
system_description.scope: Military engagements (drones, missiles, air defenses), Black Sea and port logistics, Ukrainian strike campaigns, Russian domestic political and economic responses (recruitment, repression, firing dissenting economists), NATO and neighbouring airspace/security incidents, sanctions and international diplomatic reactions, and defence/tech supply chains.
system_description.super_system: Euro-Atlantic security architecture and the broader global geopolitical order (NATO–EU–Russia–global markets interaction).
adjacent_subsystems: NATO force posture, air defense and regional deterrence
Global energy and maritime shipping markets (Black Sea exports, oil routing)
Russian domestic politics and economic resilience/repression
Defense-technology and commercial communications (drones, EW, satellite links)

variables.name: Long-range strike capability
variables.description: Measures the availability, reach and effectiveness of long-range unmanned and precision strike systems that can conduct remote attacks.

variables.name: Airspace control integrity
variables.description: Measures the degree to which aerial defenses and monitoring maintain control of national and regional airspace and deny hostile incursions.

variables.name: Port throughput
variables.description: Measures the volume and continuity of maritime cargo and export flows moving through regional ports and terminals.

variables.name: Logistics rerouting rate
variables.description: Measures the rate at which trade and supply routes are diverted or rerouted in response to attacks, closures or insurance and security risks.

variables.name: Critical infrastructure damage rate
variables.description: Measures the frequency and pace at which energy, transport, communications and storage infrastructure are being degraded or disabled.

variables.name: Supply chain resilience
variables.description: Measures the stored capacity, redundancy and ability of logistics and procurement networks to absorb shocks and restore flows.

variables.name: Defense supply levels
variables.description: Measures available inventories of munitions, air-defense interceptors, spares and other materiel needed to sustain operations.

variables.name: Escalation pressure
variables.description: Measures perceived and measured pressure in the system that pushes actors toward reciprocal or ampliative military responses.

variables.name: Deterrence credibility
variables.description: Measures how credible and effective deterrent postures and threats are judged to be by relevant actors and adversaries.

variables.name: Sanctions and economic coercion pressure
variables.description: Measures the intensity and economic bite of trade restrictions, financial measures and related external economic pressures.

variables.name: Domestic political repression intensity
variables.description: Measures the scale and severity of domestic control measures, censorship and punitive actions against dissent and economic actors.

variables.name: Economic resilience
variables.description: Measures the broader economy's capacity to absorb shocks, maintain essential functions and adjust to disruptions in trade and finance.

variables.name: Intelligence sharing and flow rate
variables.description: Measures the tempo and volume of actionable intelligence, targeting data and operational coordination exchanged among actors.

variables.name: Electronic warfare effectiveness
variables.description: Measures the effectiveness of electronic and cyber measures to degrade, detect or deny adversary sensors, communications and guidance.

variables.name: Information operations intensity
variables.description: Measures the scale and aggressiveness of information, disinformation and narrative campaigns that shape perceptions and political support.

variables.name: Force mobilization rate
variables.description: Measures the speed and scale at which manpower, units and reserve capabilities are being recruited, conscripted or activated.

catalysts.title: Continued Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian interior
catalysts.description: Sustained drone attacks on Moscow region and Russian logistics are likely to continue, pressuring air defenses and prompting further reciprocal strikes.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Ukrainian drones strike Moscow region', 'Ukraine presses drone attacks on Moscow and logistics', 'Russia downs 180 drones'

catalysts.title: NATO/Romania airspace shootdowns and intercept operations
catalysts.description: Ongoing shootdowns and NATO jet intercepts of drones over member airspace will sustain heightened air-defence activity and coalition intelligence sharing.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'NATO Jet Downs Drone', 'Romania shoots down drone that breached its airspace', 'NATO Jets Down Suspected Russian Drone Over Romania'

catalysts.title: Ongoing Black Sea port disruptions from drone/missile strikes
catalysts.description: Attacks on Black Sea terminals and ports will continue to interrupt oil and grain loadings, forcing reroutes and constraining throughput.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Sheskharis terminal halts loadings after drone attack', 'Novorossiysk port resumes oil loadings after drone attack', 'Russia hits Izmail and Odesa ports'

catalysts.title: Black Sea truce offer and diplomatic responses
catalysts.description: Ukraine's truce offer and Russia's rejection begin diplomatic activity around a Black Sea ceasefire; outcome uncertain but will affect shipping and escalation.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Ukraine offers Russia truce in Black Sea', 'Russia dismisses idea of Black Sea ceasefire'

catalysts.title: EU's planned far-reaching sanctions package (autumn)
catalysts.description: The EU's announced autumn sanctions package is likely to advance, increasing economic coercion and altering trade calculus around the conflict.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'EU plans most far-reaching sanctions package against Russia in autumn', 'EU plans most far-reaching sanctions against Russia in coming months'

catalysts.title: Air-defence interceptor depletion and urgent resupply pressure
catalysts.description: Reports of Patriot launchers running empty will prompt urgent resupply requests and short-term shortages affecting defensive coverage.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Ukraine left exposed as Patriot launchers run empty'

catalysts.title: Risk of further attacks on nuclear and critical sites
catalysts.description: The reported drone explosion at Zaporizhzhia and other strikes raise the risk of further strikes on nuclear or critical infrastructure, increasing escalation stakes.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'IAEA: drone exploded at Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant bus stop, killing one'

catalysts.title: Russia reroutes Kazakh crude to Black Sea
catalysts.description: Russia shifting Kazakh crude to Black Sea terminals to free Baltic capacity will change regional flows and require logistics adjustments.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Russia reroutes Kazakh crude to Black Sea to free Baltic export capacity'

catalysts.title: Accelerated drone and electronic-warfare demonstrations and deals
catalysts.description: New drone tests, EW demonstrations and international procurement talks suggest rising EW effectiveness and unmanned strike capabilities.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Kratos Valkyrie demonstrates electronic warfare', 'German drone maker Helsing enlists Rakuten to broker Japan military deal'
